column1: Purpose: Log your revenue, costs and call numbers once per day, so you know your real margins, cost per client and funnel rates every month.
1. Fill in one row per day for the yellow columns. Log revenue, cash, fees and costs on the day they happen, and Ad Spend straight from Ads Manager.
2. Enter Active Clients once on the 1st of the month, and Median Client Payment once on the last day of the month.
3. The blue columns calculate themselves. Show Rate is Calls Attended divided by Calls Booked. Close Rate is Clients Acquired divided by Calls Attended.
4. The purple Week row and red Month row add up the yellow columns, then calculate the blue columns from those totals. Do not type into them.
